BELLKEEPER-BRASS_HANDBELL.title: Brass Handbell
BELLKEEPER-BRASS_HANDBELL.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Morning Bell[/gold] into your Hand.
BELLKEEPER-BRASS_HANDBELL.flavor: A small handbell once used to wake the apprentices before the lower belfry collapsed.
BELLKEEPER-CRACKED_CLAY_MOLD.title: Cracked Clay Mold
BELLKEEPER-CRACKED_CLAY_MOLD.description: At the start of each combat, gain 4 [gold]Guard[/gold] and 4 [gold]Peal[/gold].
BELLKEEPER-CRACKED_CLAY_MOLD.flavor: A shard of the outer casting mold, its inner wall still scorched with bronze.
BELLKEEPER-WORN_BLIND_CANE.title: Worn Blind Cane
BELLKEEPER-WORN_BLIND_CANE.description: The first time you [gold]Sink[/gold] a card each combat, draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy.
BELLKEEPER-WORN_BLIND_CANE.flavor: Tapped against stone steps for a lifetime, its tip is smoother than river pebble.
BELLKEEPER-SILENT_STRIKER.title: Silent Striker
BELLKEEPER-SILENT_STRIKER.description: Whenever you [gold]Toll[/gold], gain 3 [gold]Block[/gold] for each distinct [gold]Chime[/gold] removed.
BELLKEEPER-SILENT_STRIKER.flavor: A bronze clapper wrapped in burlap; striking it yields only a muffled shudder.
BELLKEEPER-FRAYED_SHOULDER_PAD.title: Frayed Shoulder Pad
BELLKEEPER-FRAYED_SHOULDER_PAD.descripti: The first time [gold]Burden[/gold] triggers each combat, lose 1 less Energy and draw 1 card.
BELLKEEPER-FRAYED_SHOULDER_PAD.flavor: A thick hemp pad crushed flat by timber beams, its reed stuffing long since matted.
BELLKEEPER-TUNING_METRONOME.title: Tuning Metronome
BELLKEEPER-TUNING_METRONOME.description: At the end of your turn, if you have an even number of cards in Hand, gain 3 [gold]Guard[/gold]; if odd, gain 3 [gold]Peal[/gold].
BELLKEEPER-TUNING_METRONOME.flavor: No matter how the Spire twists around it, its swing never falters by a hair.
BELLKEEPER-CENTENNIAL_PENDULUM.title: Centennial Pendulum
BELLKEEPER-CENTENNIAL_PENDULUM.descripti: Every 3 turns, at the start of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Sustain[/gold].
BELLKEEPER-CENTENNIAL_PENDULUM.flavor: Hung a century ago, the heavy bob still sways on sheer inertia.
BELLKEEPER-TONGUELESS_BELL.title: Tongueless Bell
BELLKEEPER-TONGUELESS_BELL.description: [gold]Mute[/gold] no longer forces you to discard cards; instead, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies per stack.
BELLKEEPER-TONGUELESS_BELL.flavor: Stripped of its clapper, the mute bronze can only speak when slammed with the whole body.
BELLKEEPER-DISSONANT_TUNING_FORK.title: Dissonant Tuning Fork
BELLKEEPER-DISSONANT_TUNING_FORK.descrip: Whenever you draw a card from the bottom of your Draw Pile, increase its damage and [gold]Block[/gold] by 4 this turn.
BELLKEEPER-DISSONANT_TUNING_FORK.flavor: One prong is longer than the other; its note sets the teeth on edge.
BELLKEEPER-EVER_TOLLING_BELL.title: Ever-Tolling Bell
BELLKEEPER-EVER_TOLLING_BELL.description: Replaces [gold]Brass Handbell[/gold]. At the start of each combat, add an [gold]Eternal Bell[/gold] into your Hand.
BELLKEEPER-EVER_TOLLING_BELL.flavor: It needs no hand to strike it; the bronze hums of its own accord.
BELLKEEPER-BROKEN_BEAM_FRAME.title: Broken Beam Frame
BELLKEEPER-BROKEN_BEAM_FRAME.description: Gain 1 Energy at the start of your turn. At the start of each combat, gain 2 [gold]Burden[/gold] and 1 [gold]Mute[/gold].
BELLKEEPER-BROKEN_BEAM_FRAME.flavor: Splintered beams pulled from the belfry ruins, lashed together just wide enough to sling a great bell.
BELLKEEPER-FADED_GOLD_EYEBAND.title: Faded Gold Eyeband
BELLKEEPER-FADED_GOLD_EYEBAND.descriptio: Upon pickup, lose 7 Max HP. At the start of each combat, gain 2 [gold]Sustain[/gold].
BELLKEEPER-FADED_GOLD_EYEBAND.flavor: A soiled strip of linen tied across his eyes. The gold dust rubbed into the weave will never wash out—having kept the bell for so long, he too has turned yellow.
BELLKEEPER-ARCHAIC_TOOTH_FUSION.descript: Upon pickup, fuse [gold]Ringing Blow[/gold] and [gold]Vigil Bell[/gold] into [gold]{AncientCard}[/gold].
